configure.title: Igama leSikali
configure.description: Umlinganiselo wobubanzi:ukuphakama kwetshati (Jonga https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings ukufumana $ct-scales kunye ne-$ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Iyonke
configure.description: Iyonke engenyanzelekanga onokuyichaza. Ngokuchaza ixabiso elipheleleyo, isixa samaxabiso kuthotho kufuneka sibe yile yonke ukuze kuzotywe ipayi epheleleyo. Ungasebenzisa le paramitha ukuzoba iinxalenye kuphela zepayi okanye iitshati zemitha.

configure.title: Ungawahoyi aMaxabiso angeNanto
configure.description: Amaxabiso angenanto aza kungahoywa ukuphepha ukuzoba izilayi neeleyibhile ezingeyomfuneko.

advanced.title: Buyisela Idatha Emva
advanced.description: Buyisela idatha emva kuquka iileyibhile, ulandelelwano lothotho kunye noluhlu lwedatha yonke yothotho.

advanced.title: I-Donut Eqinileyo
advanced.description: Zoba amacandelo e-donut njengemilo endaweni yeestroke.

advanced.title: Icala leLeyibhile
advanced.description: Zoba amacandelo e-donut njengemilo endaweni yeestroke.

advanced.title: Ukushenxiswa kweLeyibhile
advanced.description: Ukushenxiswa kwendawo yeleyibhile ukusuka kwindawo esemgangathweni eyisiqingatha somgama weradiyasi. Eli xabiso linokuba lilungileyo okanye lingalunganga. Amaxabiso alungileyo aza kubeka ileyibhile kude nombindi.
